newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fortune Cement sees sales doubling.
newsitem.headline: Fortune Cement sees sales doubling.

text.p: Sales of Fortune Cement Corp are expected to rise to 30 million bags (40 kg each) this year from the previous year's 13.5 million, officials said at the company's annual shareholders meeting on Wednesday.
"It's going to be a good year despite stiff competition," Fortune Cement chairman Henry Sy said.
It has forecast net income of 1.2 billion pesos this year compared with 516.9 million in 1996.
Fortune Cement treasurer Arlene Keh said the projected increase in sales this year was based on strong demand in the Calabarzon region, an industrial area south of Manila.
The capacity of the firm's cement plant would be increased to 1.8 million tonnes by July this year from the present 750,000, Keh said.
Fortune Cement accounts for four percent of total cement sales in the Philippines and 50 percent of the Calabarzon region.
